name: InterContinental Shenzhen
positioning: Spanish-inspired urban resort in Shenzhen's Overseas Chinese Town, with a 10,000-square-meter Caribbean garden, a real sand beach and outdoor pool, garden-view balconies in most rooms, and a spa, next to the Splendid China theme park
best_for: Families who want a city stay with a garden beach, kids' pool and play areas
Travelers who like a resort-style garden and pool in the middle of Shenzhen
Guests visiting Overseas Chinese Town's theme parks

facts.text: The hotel is set in the heart of Shenzhen's Overseas Chinese Town.
The hotel blends Spanish-inspired elegance with modern design and time-honored local traditions.
A landscaped 10,000-square-meter Caribbean garden encircles the hotel's swimming pool.
The Caribbean garden has a real sand beach, palm trees and a Spanish boat beside the outdoor pool.
Children have an outdoor play area, a Spanish galleon, a kids' pool and waterfalls in the garden.
The indoor heated pool sits alongside a gym, sauna, steam bath and yoga studio.
Waterfall Spa and Wellness offers hydrotherapy, a sauna and steam bathing.
Guest rooms begin at 55 square meters, in styles ranging from Spanish and Chinese motifs to modern and classic designs.
Most rooms have a private balcony with views of the Caribbean-inspired garden.
Bathrooms have a spa-style bathtub, and rooms have a Bose sound system.
Lounge 1982 is named for the Shenzhen Bay Hotel, which opened on the same site in 1982, and its round shape echoes a Spanish bullring.
Splendid China theme park is about 0.2 kilometers from the hotel.
